"If a student's courses were moved online due to the pandemic,

Hello,
Please see our response to your question.
Question:
“If a student's courses were moved online due to the pandemic, the time the student spent studying online in Canada until August 31, 2024, still counts toward the length of the PGWP. However, students are highly recommended to attend in-class options when offered. The temporary policy change for in-Canada students studying online ends on August 31, 2024
It is still uncertain whether the conclusion of this temporary policy affects the pre- existing rule, which permitted students to take online courses as long as they did not exceed 50% of their program.
Could you please clarify if students in Canada can continue to take online courses
provided they do not surpass 50% of their study program?
Response:
A student can complete up to 100% of their studies online from outside Canada between March 2020 and August 31, 2022, because of a temporary COVID- 19 policy. This temporary policy was in place until August 31, 2022.
This temporary policy changed as of September 1, 2022.
To find out if these changes apply to a student and how, check the date
- that they started their program of study on the study permit application receipt that we sent them
Whichever date comes first is the lock-in date that applies to them.
If the lock in date is between September 1st, 2022 and August 31st, 2024:
- A student must complete at least 50% of their program inside Canada (online or in class). •The time spent studying online from outside of Canada before August 31, 2024, will count toward the length of their PGWP as long as it constitutes less than 50% of their program of study.
If the lock in date is after September 1st, 2024:
- They must complete at least 50% of their program in class inside Canada. The time spent studying outside of Canada will be deducted from the length of their PGWP.
For more information regarding eligibility requirements for distance learning, please visit out website: Work in Canada after you graduate: Who can apply-Canada.ca.
We hope this information is of assistance.
and Cizenship Caneda
